author: ThioJoe
description:
The videos look extremely professional, but they actually install a virus.

Hackers have a strategy that has proven very successful in tricking people. They upload highly polished how-to "tutorials" on short form video platforms like TikTok and Instagram, claiming you can get paid software for free, and all you need to do is run a PowerShell command. As you can guess, the command is completely malicious and actually instantly downloads and runs a virus, and steals as much data as it can. In this video I show you what these scam videos look like so you can avoid them.
